uncovered_features.feature_name: Containerd runtime version for Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS now use containerd runtime version 1.6.12.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Supported Kubernetes versions for cluster creation on Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support was added to launch clusters with Kubernetes versions 1.23.15-gke.2000, 1.24.9-gke.2100, and 1.25.5-gke.2100; Support was added to launch clusters with Kubernetes versions 1.23.13-gke.2000, 1.24.7-gke.2000, and 1.25.3-gke.1900.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes API compatibility for Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Kubernetes version 1.25 in Anthos clusters on AWS is marked as deprecated due to deprecated APIs; deprecated on 2022-12-13.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Supported Kubernetes versions for Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Kubernetes 1.20 support was removed for Anthos clusters on AWS, and creation or maintenance of Kubernetes 1.19 clusters is no longer supported; Creation and maintenance of Kubernetes 1.18 clusters is no longer supported for Anthos clusters on AWS; deprecated on 2022-07-07.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes 1.18 support in Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support for Kubernetes 1.18 clusters on Anthos clusters on AWS is removed; deprecated on 2021-12-14.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Launching Kubernetes 1.17 clusters on Anthos on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Creating new clusters with Kubernetes 1.17 on Anthos clusters on AWS is no longer allowed; deprecated on 2021-12-14.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Anthos Identity Service on Kubernetes 1.21+ clusters
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos Identity Service is available for Anthos clusters on AWS running Kubernetes version 1.21 and above.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Configurable Cloud Storage bucket for Anthos AWS configuration data
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS can now use a specified Cloud Storage bucket to store configuration data.
keywords: store cluster config in Cloud Storage
GCS bucket for Anthos AWS config

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes Konnectivity support in Anthos Kubernetes 1.21 clusters
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos Kubernetes 1.21 clusters now support the Kubernetes Konnectivity tool for control plane and node communication.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Launching Kubernetes 1.16 clusters on Anthos on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Creating new Kubernetes 1.16 clusters on Anthos clusters on AWS is no longer supported; deprecated on 2021-09-30.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Launching Kubernetes 1.21 clusters on Anthos on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS now support launching clusters with Kubernetes version 1.21.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Node pools with AWS R5 instances on Anthos clusters
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS now support launching node pools backed by AWS R5 instance types.
keywords: create node pools with AWS R5

uncovered_features.feature_name: OIDC configuration updates on running Anthos clusters
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Users can update the OIDC configuration on an Anthos cluster while it is running.
keywords: modify OIDC settings on running cluster

uncovered_features.feature_name: Launching Kubernetes 1.20 clusters on Anthos on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS now support launching clusters with Kubernetes version 1.20.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Running-cluster proxy settings modification
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS now allow modifying proxy settings on a running cluster.
keywords: modify proxy settings on running cluster

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security group updates for user clusters and node pools
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS supports updating security groups associated with user clusters and node pools.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Workload Identity for user clusters
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Workload Identity authentication to Google Cloud services is available for Anthos user clusters running Kubernetes 1.20 and above; Workload Identity in Anthos clusters on AWS user clusters is generally available.

uncovered_features.feature_name: gp3 Amazon EBS volume type support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS supports gp3 EBS volume types and configuration of gp3 volumes for management service, AWSCluster, and AWSNodePools.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes 1.19 support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS supports Kubernetes version 1.19.

uncovered_features.feature_name: User cluster log and metric export to Google Cloud observability
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS user clusters can export logs and metrics to Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring.

uncovered_features.feature_name: AWS EFS log collection in snapshots
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Snapshot collection now includes AWS Elastic File System logs from user cluster nodes.

uncovered_features.feature_name: AWS EFS mounting without driver installation
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS supports mounting AWS Elastic File System file systems without requiring driver installation.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes 1.18 support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS supports Kubernetes version 1.18, including CoreDNS 1.7.1 and Cluster Autoscaler 1.18.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Private Google Access image provisioning
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS supports using Private Google Access to provision images for GKE on AWS environments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: GKE on AWS Installation Preflight API Checks
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Additional preflight validation checks were introduced to enforce that required Google Cloud APIs are enabled during installation and upgrade.

uncovered_features.feature_name: GKE on AWS Service Account-based Installation and Upgrade Access
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Installation and upgrade of Anthos GKE on AWS can be performed with any authenticated Google Cloud service account without requiring allowlist access.

uncovered_features.feature_name: GKE on AWS Workload Identity
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Workload Identity enables binding Kubernetes service accounts to AWS IAM accounts and assigning per-workload IAM roles for fine-grained, least-privilege access.

uncovered_features.feature_name: HTTP/HTTPS Proxy Support for GKE on AWS Management Traffic
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Traffic between the GKE on AWS management service and Connect can now be routed through an HTTP/HTTPS proxy.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Anthos GKE on AWS Initial Beta Release
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos GKE on AWS was made available as an initial beta release.
